validation_rules: source_revision, index and build_set are orchestrator-owned and set before publication; index names the accepted 02-build-index attempt and the sha256 of its build-index.json

every unit of the accepted index appears exactly once: as itself (unit_id equal to index_unit_id) or as two or more parts with unit_id '<index_unit_id>::<part>', part matching [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*; no unit_id outside the index
every signal_ids entry exists in the accepted index
every evidence citation is a repository-relative source_file citation whose content_hash matches the checkout
an unclassified unit is named in coverage_gaps
build_set is exactly the unit_ids classed compiled-native, compiled-managed or transpiled
index_review items are recorded disagreements with the index, never applied to it; they do not by themselves make the result OK_WITH_GAPS
status OK_WITH_GAPS when any unit is unclassified or coverage_gaps is non-empty
classes and index review are static inferences; the result cannot promote them to a finding, severity or runtime state, and asserts no successful build
